name: ZEROSET
about: ZEROSET is a Korean wellness skincare brand launched in 2024, combining regional Korean botanical ingredients with modern skincare science. Our signature products are the Green Tea Peeling to Foam Cleanser with Hadong green tea and the Red Apple Jam Pack Cleanser with Chungju apples. Both offer distinctive textures that transform into foam for easy cleansing and skin-texture care. ZEROSET has expanded to Amazon US, Qoo10 Japan and Shopee Southeast Asia. In 2026, 420 units were shipped to a Philippine partner and arrived locally, with Southstar Drug SKU enrollment underway. We participated in a Daimaru Umeda pop-up in Osaka in November and signed an MOU with an Indian business partner. We seek importers, drugstore chains, beauty retailers and e-commerce distributors for long-term growth across Asia.

products.name: ZEROSET Green Tea Peeling to Foam Cleanser 120g
products.name_ko: 제로셋 그린티 필링 투 폼 클렌저 120g
products.intro: 120g. A 3-in-1 gommage-to-foam cleanser for gentle exfoliation, mask care and facial cleansing. Features Hadong green tea prepared through a 100-hour low-temperature process, Green Tea-Tox complex and cellulose-based exfoliating particles. Transforms into foam with water to remove impurities and excess sebum. Mildly acidic (pH 6.0), irritation-tested and recognized in Korea as a functional cosmetic for acne-prone skin. Contains 0.5% salicylic acid.
products.why: The unique gommage-to-foam texture combines exfoliation and cleansing in one step. Differentiators include Hadong green tea prepared over 100 hours, a vegan formula, mildly acidic pH 6.0, Korean acne-care functional cosmetic status and completed skin irritation testing.

products.name: ZEROSET Red Apple Jam Pack Cleanser 120g
products.name_ko: 제로셋 레드 애플 잼 팩 클렌저 120g
products.intro: 120g. A jam-to-foam cleanser with Chungju apple extract and PHA. Its bouncy jam-like texture gently adheres to skin and transforms into foam with water, helping remove impurities and dead skin cells. Use as a daily cleanser or a 1-2 minute rinse-off mask on dry skin. With 2% niacinamide, NMN and glutathione for a smoother, brighter-looking complexion. Skin irritation testing completed.
products.why: The distinctive jam-to-foam texture works as both a rinse-off mask and a daily cleanser. Korean Chungju apples, PHA, 2% niacinamide, NMN and glutathione create clear differentiation and an engaging in-store demonstration for beauty retailers.

name: Seoul Food CO.,LTD
about: Company Overview & Manufacturing Capabilities: SEOUL FOOD CO., LTD. is a Korean manufacturer specializing in processed seafood products, including fish cakes, skewered fish cakes, and fish cake soups. We operate one of Korea's largest skewered fish cake production lines, ensuring stable production capacity and consistent product quality. Proven Market Performance: We maintain HACCP, FSSC 22000, and ISO 45001 certifications. Since beginning exports in 2017, we have expanded into international markets, including the USA, Canada, Japan, China, and Australia. Our export sales reached approximately USD 360,000 in 2025. What We Offer Buyers: We provide a wide range of fish cake products with customizable packaging and specifications. We also support OEM and private-label (PB) manufacturing, offering tailored product development to meet the needs of international buyers.

products.name: Fish Cake Hotpot
products.intro: Fish Cake Hotpot (358g) is a convenient Korean fish cake soup kit featuring assorted fish cakes with a variety of shapes and textures. The included soup sauce creates a rich, savory broth, allowing easy preparation without complicated ingredients. Its chewy fish cakes and flavorful soup make it ideal for home meals, side dishes, camping, or casual dining. A convenient way to enjoy authentic Korean-style fish cake soup.

products.name: Square Fish Cake
products.intro: Square Fish Cake (1kg) is a traditional Korean fish cake featuring a mild, savory flavor and a soft, chewy texture. Its versatile square shape makes it ideal for stir-fried dishes, soups, hotpots, and tteokbokki (Korean spicy rice cakes). The 1kg bulk package is suitable for households, restaurants, and foodservice distributors. It is a convenient and versatile ingredient for preparing a wide variety of authentic Korean dishes.

name: MEREN
about: (1) MEREN is a designer jewelry brand whose pieces hold their own when worn alone. We reinterpret forms found in traditional Korean objects and architecture as contemporary jewelry. Our 41 pieces of 925 sterling silver jewelry span three lines: VASE (celadon melon-shaped bottle), ARCH (roof tiles and brick walls) and WALL (bricks and dressed stone), all made in Seoul. Designer Soheon, in jewelry since 1996, leads every design. (2) Since opening our online store in August 2026, we have joined Ring Week in Seoul 2026, held pop-ups at DDP and Lotte Department Store Busan, and are stocked at concept stores Gonggan Bichae (Jeonju Hanok Village) and Sodam Sanghoe with LOTTE ON (Seoul Forest). We also sell on Lotte ON and Qoo10 Japan. (3) We supply finished branded products with English product information, wear images, videos and the design source behind each piece. Supply terms are discussed at the meeting.

products.name: VASE Melon Bold Ring
products.intro: 925 sterling silver ring, 8 mm wide, Korean sizes 8-22, unplated. Its form comes from the full body and petal-like mouth of a celadon melon-shaped bottle. Repeating rounded surfaces carry the bottle's vertical ridges, and the central volume tapers toward the sides for balance on the hand. The signature ring of the VASE line, available with a matching slim ring, necklace and earrings.
products.why: Not a copied motif: the curves and proportions of a celadon melon-shaped bottle (National Museum of Korea collection) are reinterpreted as a ring. The clear source gives buyers a ready sales story. Designed by Soheon, in jewelry since 1996; made in Seoul in unplated 925 silver.

products.name: VASE Neck Necklace
products.intro: 925 sterling silver necklace, unplated. It starts from the curve of a celadon melon-shaped bottle, where the body narrows into the neck and opens again toward the mouth. The 6 x 8 mm pendant is gently hollowed at the center and opens softly at the sides. One size: 40 cm chain plus 2 cm and 3 cm extenders (45 cm total). Matching rings and earrings are available.
products.why: The narrow neck curve of a celadon melon-shaped bottle (National Museum of Korea collection), distilled into one small pendant. The clear source gives buyers a ready sales story, and one size means no size-by-size stock. Made in Seoul in unplated 925 silver.

name: Daon International Co., Ltd.
about: ATHIS is a Seoul-born aromatherapy and fragrance brand operated by Daon International Co., Ltd. We develop reed diffusers, room sprays, fabric perfumes, essential oils, aroma roll-ons, hand creams, body oils and incense. Our Sinsa-dong atelier provides direct customer contact and fragrance consultation. We have online sales experience in Japan, the United States and Singapore, and are currently working on a 9,408-unit diffuser supply project for W Cosmetics in Australia and New Zealand. We offer ATHIS-branded finished goods for home and beauty retailers, lifestyle stores, hotels and spas. Buyers can discuss product, scent and size assortments, with signature Phytoncide and Sleeping collections connecting home fragrance and personal care. Trial orders start at USD 500, followed by regular orders from USD 1,000.

products.name: Phytoncide Reed Diffuser, 120 mL / 250 mL
products.intro: Inspired by forest bathing, this reed diffuser brings the scent of the woods into everyday spaces. Personally composed by our founder using only natural fragrance ingredients, it blends pine, eucalyptus, hinoki and fir needle into a gentle forest aroma. Sesame wood reeds complement its botanical character. Available in 120 mL and 250 mL.
products.why: A signature scent personally composed by our founder using 100% natural fragrance ingredients. Its gentle forest aroma and sesame wood reeds evoke the sensory experience of forest bathing. A matching room spray supports coordinated wellness collections and gift assortments.

products.name: Sleeping Body Oil
products.intro: Sleeping Body Oil is designed for wellness-conscious consumers who invest in quality sleep and self-care. Paired with a gua sha tool, it creates a pre-bedtime massage ritual to unwind after a busy day. Combining moisturising care, fragrance and massage, it suits premium beauty, lifestyle and spa retailers serving customers seeking restorative evening routines.
products.why: Inspired by the founder's personal experience with insomnia, it offers a clear bedtime ritual beyond moisturising. Pairing the oil with gua sha creates an intuitive wellness set.

name: Liberte
about: Company & Products Founded in 2019, Liberte operates LIBERTECO, a Korean home lifestyle brand offering vintage-inspired home decor and furniture through OEM production. Market Presence Our products are sold through major Korean platforms, including Ohouse, 29CM, W Concept, and Kakao Gift, as well as Hyundai Department Store pop-ups. We have approximately 30,000 Instagram followers and a growing international audience. International Partnerships We offer wholesale distribution of LIBERTECO products with negotiable MOQs and supply terms. We are expanding into Japan through department store pop-ups and local retail partnerships.

products.name: Vintage style wall clock
products.intro: LIBERTECO's vintage-style wall clock is an analog timepiece that combines classic design with soft, elegant colors. Featuring a retro-inspired frame and a clean, simple dial, it serves as both a functional clock and a decorative accent for living rooms, kitchens, and bedrooms. Available in a range of pastel colors, it is ideal for customers who appreciate vintage-inspired interiors or are looking for a stylish housewarming gift.
products.why: LIBERTECO stands out with its signature pastel colors and unique color combinations. Blending classic vintage aesthetics with modern features such as a silent movement and built-in timer, our wall clocks offer both functionality and decorative appeal at an affordable price.

products.name: Vintage Home Storage Collection
products.intro: LIBERTECO's Vintage Home Storage Collection offers versatile storage for supplements, cosmetics, and everyday essentials. Inspired by 1970s bread boxes, it features classic tinware-style designs and our signature pastel colors. The products can be placed in kitchens or living rooms to organize daily items while serving as decorative accents. Designed for customers who appreciate vintage interiors and stylish organization, the collection includes multi-purpose bread boxes and flower buckets.
products.why: LIBERTECO transforms 1970s-inspired bread boxes into versatile storage for vitamins, supplements, cosmetics and everyday essentials. Signature pastel colors and nostalgic tinware designs distinguish the collection from conventional storage products.

name: FORER CO., LTD.
about: Founded in 2024, GOYOUHAN is a sustainable brand producing stationery and lifestyle goods (laptop pouches, diaries, card wallets, passport cases) from 100% biodegradable paper leather and upcycled materials, conducting all processes from design to production in South Korea. Surpassing 100% of its funding goal on Makuake(Japan), GOYOUHAN actively exports (FOB) to France, Germany, Japan, and Taiwan. Selected for the 2025 Upcycling Industry Promotion Support Program, we supplied ESG goods to public and corporate clients like Sejong Center for the Performing Arts and Gyeonggi Cultural Foundation, and exhibited at Maison&Objet in France, Korea ESG Eco-Friendly Expo, Seoul Design Festival, and Craft Trend Fair. We support original brand exports (FOB) and 1:1 custom production (logo debossing, reclaimed-waste goods; MOQ 50 units, 10-day lead time) with one-stop service covering design, sampling, manufacturing, and delivery, plus English catalogs and marketing materials.

products.name: Paper leather laptop sleeve
products.intro: This sleeve-style laptop pouch holds both a laptop and documents. Weighing around 100g, it features a practical magnetic closure for easy opening and closing. The main pocket fits a laptop and documents, while the sub-pocket stores a tablet or diary. Its flap doubles as a mousepad or holds memo notes. Made from eco-friendly paper leather, which is lighter than traditional leather, it is water-resistant and highly tear-resistant.

products.name: Paper leather passport case
products.intro: This card-wallet style all-in-one passport case eliminates the hassle of traditional bi-fold designs. Its versatile layout neatly stores your passport, boarding pass, cards, and tickets all in one place. An embedded RFID-blocking film protects e-passports and credit cards from data theft. Made from eco-friendly paper leather, which is lighter than traditional leather, it is water-resistant and highly tear-resistant.

name: Dalim, Inc.
about: Company Overview Founded in 2006, DALIM, Inc. is a Korean medical device manufacturer specializing in scar management gels and personal lubricants, operating under a GMP-based quality system. Product Quality SCARGEL COMBINATION (MFDS Class II) is sold in Korea. VALM-CARE (MFDS Class III) offers 2g applicators and 15–150g tubes, supported by safety and stability testing. Business Opportunities We offer branded products, OEM/private-label manufacturing, and regulatory documentation for global distributors.

products.name: Scargel Combination
products.intro: SCARGEL COMBINATION is an MFDS-approved Class II silicone scar management gel. Formulated with silicone, onion, Centella asiatica and paper mulberry extracts. Apply a thin layer to scar areas. Ideal for post-surgical and injury scars. Available in 15g, 30g and 60g sizes.

products.name: VALM-CARE
products.intro: VALM-CARE is an MFDS-approved Class III personal lubricant designed to relieve vaginal dryness and reduce friction. Formulated with hydroxyethylcellulose, carbomer, chamomile extract and allantoin. Apply as needed. For adult women. Available in 2g single-use applicators and 15–150g tubes.

name: Scandimom Co., Ltd.
about: 1. SCANDIMOM is a Korean premium baby-care brand with over 30 years of industry experience. We develop and distribute newborn swaddles and baby bedding, including Supreme, Suit, Classic and Half swaddles in Tencel, bamboo and cotton, plus Duraron cooling bedding. 2. Our anti-Moro-reflex swaddle band is patented in Korea (No. 10-1922307). We have won BEFE awards for three consecutive years. Company data shows approximately ninefold sales growth from 2020 to 2024. We have exhibited in Japan, Vietnam and Germany. 3. Our products feature anti-startle bands, two-way zippers, backhand openings, and various fabrics and sizes. We seek wholesale and brand distribution partnerships with overseas baby-product importers, distributors and specialty retailers.

products.name: Swaddle Supreme
products.intro: Swaddle Supreme is a Korean-made swaddle designed for newborns and infants. Tencel Lite and Mesh options contain 95% Tencel and 5% stretch fiber. Dress the baby in the swaddle and adjust its patented anti-startle band for a snug fit. Backhand openings allow hand movement, while a two-way zipper simplifies diaper changes. Available in S (3-6 kg), M (6-8.5 kg), and L (8.5-12 kg).

products.name: Duraron Cooling Baby Waterproof Pad
products.intro: SCANDIMOM Duraron Cooling Baby Pad is designed for babies and toddlers. Made with Duraron cooling fabric, it provides a refreshing feel on contact. Its waterproof layer protects bedding from moisture, while a non-slip design helps prevent shifting. Simply place it on a baby mattress or bed for comfortable everyday use. Ideal for families with infants, it combines cooling comfort and practical protection.
